form.label: USB Monitoring & DLP
form.description: USB device, attributed file copy, HID and locked-file activity. Requires index=usb_monitoring, the usb_normalize macro, the usb_file_attribution lookup, and the usb_allowlist lookup.

search.query: index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=6416 | `usb_normalize` | search usb_class=USBSTOR | stats count

index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=11 | `usb_normalize` | eval file_time=strftime(_time,"%s") | lookup usb_file_attribution.csv host file_path file_time OUTPUTNEW usb_serial | where isnotnull(usb_serial) | stats count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=6416 | `usb_normalize` | search usb_class=HID | stats count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=11 | `usb_normalize` | where lower(file_ext)="locked" AND like(lower(file_path), "c:%") | stats count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json | timechart span=1h count by event.code
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=6416 | `usb_normalize` | search usb_class=USBSTOR | stats count by usb_letter | sort -count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=6416 | `usb_normalize` | stats count by host | sort -count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=6416 | `usb_normalize` | search usb_class=USBSTOR | stats count by usb_serial host | sort -count

index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=11 | `usb_normalize` | eval file_time=strftime(_time,"%s") | lookup usb_file_attribution.csv host file_path file_time OUTPUTNEW usb_serial | where isnotnull(usb_serial) | stats count by user usb_serial host | sort -count
index=usb_monitoring sourcetype=usb_monitoring_json event.code=11 | `usb_normalize` | where lower(file_ext)="locked" AND like(lower(file_path), "c:%") | stats count by host process_name | sort -count
